fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="EffectiveFrom" StaticName="EffectiveFrom" DisplayName="EffectiveFrom" Required="TRUE"><Validation Message="Use a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.">=AND(LEN([EffectiveFrom])=10,MID([EffectiveFrom],5,1)="-",MID([EffectiveFrom],8,1)="-",LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4)=TEXT(VALUE(LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4)),"0000"),MID([EffectiveFrom],6,2)=TEXT(VALUE(MID([EffectiveFrom],6,2)),"00"),RIGHT([EffectiveFrom],2)=TEXT(VALUE(RIGHT([EffectiveFrom],2)),"00"),VALUE(LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4))>=1,VALUE(MID([EffectiveFrom],6,2))>=1,VALUE(MID([EffectiveFrom],6,2))<=12,VALUE(RIGHT([EffectiveFrom],2))>=1,VALUE(RIGHT([EffectiveFrom],2))<=CHOOSE(VALUE(MID([EffectiveFrom],6,2)),31,IF(OR(MOD(VALUE(LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4)),400)=0,AND(MOD(VALUE(LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4)),4)=0,MOD(VALUE(LEFT([EffectiveFrom],4)),100)<>0)),29,28),31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31))</Validation></Field>
